data.name: events_status_transition_guard
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER events_status_transition_guard
BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON events
WHEN NEW.status <> OLD.status AND NOT (
  (OLD.status = 'upcoming' AND NEW.status = 'registration') OR
  (OLD.status = 'registration' AND NEW.status = 'inProgress') OR
  (OLD.status = 'inProgress' AND NEW.status = 'completed') OR
  (OLD.status = 'completed' AND NEW.status = 'archived')
)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid event status transition');
END;

data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER team_members_eligibility_guard
BEFORE INSERT ON team_members
WHEN NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM teams t
  JOIN event_divisions d ON d.id = t.division_id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL
  JOIN events e ON e.id = d.event_id AND e.deleted_at IS NULL
  JOIN event_participants ep ON ep.event_id = e.id AND ep.player_id = NEW.player_id
    AND ep.deleted_at IS NULL AND ep.check_in_status = 'checkedIn'
  JOIN division_participants dp ON dp.event_participant_id = ep.id
    AND dp.division_id = d.id AND dp.deleted_at IS NULL
  WHERE t.id = NEW.team_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND e.status = 'registration'
)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'team member is not eligible');
END;

data.name: team_members_unique_division_guard
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER team_members_unique_division_guard
BEFORE INSERT ON team_members
WHEN EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM team_members tm
  JOIN teams existing_team ON existing_team.id = tm.team_id AND existing_team.deleted_at IS NULL
  JOIN teams new_team ON new_team.id = NEW.team_id
  WHERE tm.player_id = NEW.player_id AND tm.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND existing_team.division_id = new_team.division_id
)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'player already belongs to an active team in this division');
END;

data.name: event_divisions_setup_lock_guard
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER event_divisions_setup_lock_guard
BEFORE UPDATE OF name, tournament_format, deleted_at ON event_divisions
WHEN ((NEW.name IS NOT OLD.name OR NEW.deleted_at IS NOT OLD.deleted_at)
  AND (SELECT status FROM events WHERE id=OLD.event_id) <> 'upcoming'
  AND (SELECT deleted_at FROM events WHERE id=OLD.event_id) IS NULL)
 OR (NEW.tournament_format IS NOT OLD.tournament_format AND
   ((SELECT status FROM events WHERE id=OLD.event_id) <> 'registration'
    OR OLD.deleted_at IS NOT NULL
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM matches WHERE division_id=OLD.id)))
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'division setup or tournament format is locked');
END;

data.name: matches_final_score_insert_guard
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER matches_final_score_insert_guard
BEFORE INSERT ON matches
WHEN NEW.status='completed' AND NOT (
  ((max(NEW.side_one_score,NEW.side_two_score)=11 AND min(NEW.side_one_score,NEW.side_two_score) BETWEEN 0 AND 9)
    OR (min(NEW.side_one_score,NEW.side_two_score)>=10 AND abs(NEW.side_one_score-NEW.side_two_score)=2))
  AND NEW.winner_team_id=CASE WHEN NEW.side_one_score>NEW.side_two_score THEN NEW.side_one_team_id ELSE NEW.side_two_team_id END)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid final score or derived winner');
END;

data.name: matches_completed_result_lock
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER matches_completed_result_lock BEFORE UPDATE ON matches
WHEN OLD.status='completed' AND (NEW.side_one_score IS NOT OLD.side_one_score
 OR NEW.side_two_score IS NOT OLD.side_two_score OR NEW.winner_team_id IS NOT OLD.winner_team_id
 OR NEW.side_one_team_id IS NOT OLD.side_one_team_id OR NEW.side_two_team_id IS NOT OLD.side_two_team_id)
 AND (NEW.side_one_team_id IS NOT OLD.side_one_team_id OR NEW.side_two_team_id IS NOT OLD.side_two_team_id
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM match_result_revisions r WHERE r.match_id=OLD.id
   AND json_extract(r.previous_result,'$.version')=OLD.version
   AND json_extract(r.previous_result,'$.side_one_score')=OLD.side_one_score
   AND json_extract(r.previous_result,'$.side_two_score')=OLD.side_two_score))
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'audited result correction required'); END;

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "players" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 0), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trim(display_name) <> ''), "skill_level" INTEGER CHECK (skill_level IS NULL OR skill_level BETWEEN 1 AND 5), PRIMARY KEY(id), CHECK(updated_at >= created_at), CHECK(deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= updated_at));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "events" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 0), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trim(name) <> ''), "scheduled_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (event_type IN ('casual', 'formal')), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('upcoming', 'registration', 'inProgress', 'completed', 'archived')), "entry_fee_minor_units" INTEGER NULL, "entry_fee_currency" TEXT NULL, "court_label" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trim(court_label) <> ''), PRIMARY KEY(id), CHECK((entry_fee_minor_units IS NULL AND entry_fee_currency IS NULL)OR(entry_fee_minor_units >= 0 AND entry_fee_currency GLOB '[A-Z][A-Z][A-Z]')), CHECK(updated_at >= created_at), CHECK(deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= updated_at));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_divisions" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 0), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trim(name) <> ''), "tournament_format" TEXT CHECK (tournament_format IS NULL OR tournament_format IN ('singleElimination', 'doubleElimination', 'singleRoundRobin', 'doubleRoundRobin')), PRIMARY KEY(id), CHECK(updated_at >= created_at), CHECK(deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= updated_at));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_participants" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 0), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "player_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES players(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "check_in_status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (check_in_status IN ('notPresent', 'checkedIn')), PRIMARY KEY(id), CHECK(updated_at >= created_at), CHECK(deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= updated_at));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "division_participants" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 0), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "division_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event_divisions(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "event_participant_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event_participants(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY(id), CHECK(updated_at >= created_at), CHECK(deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= updated_at));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "participant_payments" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 0), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_participant_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event_participants(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "division_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES event_divisions(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('unpaid', 'paid')), PRIMARY KEY(id), CHECK(updated_at >= created_at), CHECK(deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= updated_at));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "teams" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 0), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "division_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event_divisions(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "formation_method" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (formation_method IN ('manual', 'random', 'balanced')), "display_label" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id), CHECK(display_label IS NULL OR trim(display_label) <> ''), CHECK(updated_at >= created_at), CHECK(deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= updated_at));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "team_members" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 0), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "team_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES teams(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "player_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES players(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY(team_id, player_id), CHECK(updated_at >= created_at), CHECK(deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= updated_at));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "matches" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 0), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "division_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event_divisions(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "side_one_team_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES teams(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "side_two_team_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES teams(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('scheduled', 'queued', 'inProgress', 'completed')), "side_one_score" INTEGER NULL, "side_two_score" INTEGER NULL, "winner_team_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES teams(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "round_number" INTEGER NULL, "sequence_number" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id), CHECK(side_one_team_id IS NULL OR side_two_team_id IS NULL OR side_one_team_id <> side_two_team_id), CHECK(side_one_score IS NULL OR side_one_score >= 0), CHECK(side_two_score IS NULL OR side_two_score >= 0), CHECK(round_number IS NULL OR round_number > 0), CHECK(sequence_number IS NULL OR sequence_number > 0), CHECK((status = 'completed' AND side_one_team_id IS NOT NULL AND side_two_team_id IS NOT NULL AND side_one_score IS NOT NULL AND side_two_score IS NOT NULL AND winner_team_id IS NOT NULL AND winner_team_id IN (side_one_team_id, side_two_team_id))OR(status <> 'completed' AND winner_team_id IS NULL)), CHECK(updated_at >= created_at), CHECK(deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= updated_at));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "match_dependencies" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 0), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "source_match_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES matches(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "source_outcome" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_outcome IN ('winner', 'loser')), "destination_match_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES matches(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "destination_slot" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (destination_slot IN ('sideOne', 'sideTwo')), PRIMARY KEY(source_match_id, source_outcome, destination_match_id, destination_slot), CHECK(source_match_id <> destination_match_id), CHECK(updated_at >= created_at), CHECK(deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= updated_at));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "court_queue_entries" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 0), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "division_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES event_divisions(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "match_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES matches(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "queue_position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (queue_position >= 0), PRIMARY KEY(id), CHECK(updated_at >= created_at), CHECK(deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= updated_at));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "division_placements" ("created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 0), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "division_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event_divisions(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "team_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES teams(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (position > 0), PRIMARY KEY(id), CHECK(updated_at >= created_at), CHECK(deleted_at IS NULL OR deleted_at >= updated_at));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_outbox_operations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (entity_type = 'player'), "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES players(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "operation_kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (operation_kind IN ('upsert', 'tombstone')), "base_version" INTEGER NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(payload_json) AND json_type(payload_json) = 'object'), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempt_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_eligible_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'inFlight', 'conflicted', 'failed')), "claimed_at" TEXT NULL, "failure_code" TEXT NULL, "failure_message" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id), CHECK(base_version IS NULL OR base_version >= 0), CHECK(attempt_count >= 0), CHECK((status = 'inFlight' AND claimed_at IS NOT NULL)OR(status <> 'inFlight' AND claimed_at IS NULL)), CHECK(failure_message IS NULL OR length(failure_message) <= 240));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_pull_checkpoints" ("entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (entity_type = 'player'), "cursor_updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "cursor_entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES players(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(entity_type));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_conflicts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES sync_outbox_operations(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (entity_type = 'player'), "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES players(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "expected_version" INTEGER NULL, "local_payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(local_payload_json) AND json_type(local_payload_json) = 'object'), "remote_payload_json" TEXT NULL, "remote_version" INTEGER NULL, "detected_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('unresolved', 'resolved')), PRIMARY KEY(id), CHECK(expected_version IS NULL OR expected_version >= 0), CHECK(remote_version IS NULL OR remote_version >= 0), CHECK(remote_payload_json IS NULL OR(json_valid(remote_payload_json) AND json_type(remote_payload_json) = 'object')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_setup_outbox_operations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "base_version" INTEGER NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(payload_json) AND json_type(payload_json) = 'object'), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'blocked', 'conflicted', 'failed')), "failure_message" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id), CHECK(base_version IS NULL OR base_version >= 0), CHECK(failure_message IS NULL OR length(failure_message) <= 240));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_setup_pull_checkpoints" ("singleton" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "cursor_updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "cursor_event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(singleton), CHECK(singleton = 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_setup_conflicts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES event_setup_outbox_operations(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "local_payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(local_payload_json) AND json_type(local_payload_json) = 'object'), "remote_payload_json" TEXT NULL, "detected_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('unresolved', 'resolved')), PRIMARY KEY(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "participation_outbox_operations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_participant_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event_participants(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "base_version" INTEGER NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(payload_json) AND json_type(payload_json) = 'object'), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'blocked', 'conflicted', 'failed')), "failure_message" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id), CHECK(base_version IS NULL OR base_version >= 0), CHECK(failure_message IS NULL OR length(failure_message) <= 240));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "participation_pull_checkpoints" ("singleton" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "cursor_updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "cursor_participant_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event_participants(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(singleton), CHECK(singleton = 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "participation_conflicts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES participation_outbox_operations(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "event_participant_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event_participants(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "local_payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(local_payload_json) AND json_type(local_payload_json) = 'object'), "remote_payload_json" TEXT NULL, "detected_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('unresolved', 'resolved')), PRIMARY KEY(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "team_formation_outbox_operations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "division_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event_divisions(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(payload_json) AND json_type(payload_json) = 'object'), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'blocked', 'conflicted', 'failed')), "failure_message" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "team_formation_pull_checkpoints" ("singleton" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "cursor_updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "cursor_division_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event_divisions(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(singleton), CHECK(singleton = 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "team_formation_conflicts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES team_formation_outbox_operations(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "division_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event_divisions(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "local_payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_payload_json" TEXT NULL, "detected_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('unresolved', 'resolved')), PRIMARY KEY(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "single_elimination_snapshots" ("division_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event_divisions(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "bracket_json" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(bracket_json)), PRIMARY KEY(division_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "single_elimination_outbox" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "division_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event_divisions(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(payload_json)), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'blocked', 'failed', 'conflicted', 'accepted')), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "failure" TEXT NULL, "remote_json" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "single_elimination_checkpoints" ("scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "bracket_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(scope));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "round_robin_snapshots" ("division_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event_divisions(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "tournament_json" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(tournament_json)), PRIMARY KEY(division_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "round_robin_outbox" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "division_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event_divisions(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(payload_json)), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'blocked', 'failed', 'conflicted', 'accepted')), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "failure" TEXT NULL, "remote_json" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "round_robin_checkpoints" ("scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "tournament_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(scope));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "double_elimination_snapshots" ("division_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event_divisions(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "bracket_json" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(bracket_json)), PRIMARY KEY(division_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "double_elimination_outbox" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "division_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES event_divisions(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(payload_json)), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'blocked', 'failed', 'conflicted', 'accepted')), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "failure" TEXT NULL, "remote_json" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "double_elimination_checkpoints" ("scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "bracket_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(scope));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "match_result_revisions" ("operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "match_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES matches(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "previous_result" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(previous_result)), "reason" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trim(reason) <> ''), "recorded_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(operation_id));

CREATE TRIGGER events_status_transition_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON events WHEN NEW.status <> OLD.status AND NOT((OLD.status = 'upcoming' AND NEW.status = 'registration')OR(OLD.status = 'registration' AND NEW.status = 'inProgress')OR(OLD.status = 'inProgress' AND NEW.status = 'completed')OR(OLD.status = 'completed' AND NEW.status = 'archived'))BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'invalid event status transition');END

CREATE TRIGGER matches_status_transition_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON matches WHEN NEW.status <> OLD.status AND NOT((OLD.status = 'scheduled' AND NEW.status = 'queued')OR(OLD.status = 'queued' AND NEW.status = 'inProgress')OR(OLD.status = 'inProgress' AND NEW.status = 'completed'))BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'invalid match status transition');END

CREATE TRIGGER division_participants_scope_guard BEFORE INSERT ON division_participants WHEN (SELECT event_id FROM event_divisions WHERE id = NEW.division_id) <> (SELECT event_id FROM event_participants WHERE id = NEW.event_participant_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'division participant event mismatch');END

CREATE TRIGGER division_participants_scope_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF division_id, event_participant_id ON division_participants WHEN (SELECT event_id FROM event_divisions WHERE id = NEW.division_id) <> (SELECT event_id FROM event_participants WHERE id = NEW.event_participant_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'division participant event mismatch');END

CREATE TRIGGER participant_payments_scope_guard BEFORE INSERT ON participant_payments WHEN NEW.division_id IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT event_id FROM event_divisions WHERE id = NEW.division_id) <> (SELECT event_id FROM event_participants WHERE id = NEW.event_participant_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'payment division event mismatch');END

CREATE TRIGGER participant_payments_scope_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF division_id, event_participant_id ON participant_payments WHEN NEW.division_id IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT event_id FROM event_divisions WHERE id = NEW.division_id) <> (SELECT event_id FROM event_participants WHERE id = NEW.event_participant_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'payment division event mismatch');END

CREATE TRIGGER matches_team_scope_guard BEFORE INSERT ON matches WHEN(NEW.side_one_team_id IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT division_id FROM teams WHERE id = NEW.side_one_team_id) <> NEW.division_id)OR(NEW.side_two_team_id IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT division_id FROM teams WHERE id = NEW.side_two_team_id) <> NEW.division_id)OR(NEW.winner_team_id IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT division_id FROM teams WHERE id = NEW.winner_team_id) <> NEW.division_id)BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'match team division mismatch');END

CREATE TRIGGER matches_team_scope_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF division_id, side_one_team_id, side_two_team_id, winner_team_id ON matches WHEN(NEW.side_one_team_id IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT division_id FROM teams WHERE id = NEW.side_one_team_id) <> NEW.division_id)OR(NEW.side_two_team_id IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT division_id FROM teams WHERE id = NEW.side_two_team_id) <> NEW.division_id)OR(NEW.winner_team_id IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT division_id FROM teams WHERE id = NEW.winner_team_id) <> NEW.division_id)BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'match team division mismatch');END

CREATE TRIGGER match_dependencies_scope_guard BEFORE INSERT ON match_dependencies WHEN (SELECT division_id FROM matches WHERE id = NEW.source_match_id) <> (SELECT division_id FROM matches WHERE id = NEW.destination_match_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'match dependency division mismatch');END

CREATE TRIGGER match_dependencies_scope_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF source_match_id, destination_match_id ON match_dependencies WHEN (SELECT division_id FROM matches WHERE id = NEW.source_match_id) <> (SELECT division_id FROM matches WHERE id = NEW.destination_match_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'match dependency division mismatch');END

CREATE TRIGGER court_queue_entries_scope_guard BEFORE INSERT ON court_queue_entries WHEN (SELECT event_id FROM event_divisions WHERE id = (SELECT division_id FROM matches WHERE id = NEW.match_id)) <> NEW.event_id OR(NEW.division_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.division_id <> (SELECT division_id FROM matches WHERE id = NEW.match_id))BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'court queue scope mismatch');END

CREATE TRIGGER court_queue_entries_scope_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF event_id, division_id, match_id ON court_queue_entries WHEN (SELECT event_id FROM event_divisions WHERE id = (SELECT division_id FROM matches WHERE id = NEW.match_id)) <> NEW.event_id OR(NEW.division_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.division_id <> (SELECT division_id FROM matches WHERE id = NEW.match_id))BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'court queue scope mismatch');END

CREATE TRIGGER division_placements_scope_guard BEFORE INSERT ON division_placements WHEN (SELECT division_id FROM teams WHERE id = NEW.team_id) <> NEW.division_id BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'placement team division mismatch');END

CREATE TRIGGER division_placements_scope_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF division_id, team_id ON division_placements WHEN (SELECT division_id FROM teams WHERE id = NEW.team_id) <> NEW.division_id BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'placement team division mismatch');END

CREATE TRIGGER events_format_required_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON events WHEN NEW.status = 'inProgress' AND OLD.status <> 'inProgress' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM event_divisions WHERE event_id = NEW.id AND deleted_at IS NULL AND tournament_format IS NULL) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'tournament formats must be configured before event begins');END

CREATE TRIGGER team_members_eligibility_guard BEFORE INSERT ON team_members WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teams AS t JOIN event_divisions AS d ON d.id = t.division_id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN events AS e ON e.id = d.event_id AND e.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN event_participants AS ep ON ep.event_id = e.id AND ep.player_id = NEW.player_id AND ep.deleted_at IS NULL AND ep.check_in_status = 'checkedIn' JOIN division_participants AS dp ON dp.event_participant_id = ep.id AND dp.division_id = d.id AND dp.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE t.id = NEW.team_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND e.status = 'registration') BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'team member is not eligible');END

CREATE TRIGGER team_members_unique_division_guard BEFORE INSERT ON team_members WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_members AS tm JOIN teams AS existing_team ON existing_team.id = tm.team_id AND existing_team.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN teams AS new_team ON new_team.id = NEW.team_id WHERE tm.player_id = NEW.player_id AND tm.deleted_at IS NULL AND existing_team.division_id = new_team.division_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'player already belongs to an active team in this division');END

CREATE TRIGGER event_divisions_setup_lock_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF name, tournament_format, deleted_at ON event_divisions WHEN((NEW.name IS NOT OLD.name OR NEW.deleted_at IS NOT OLD.deleted_at)AND (SELECT status FROM events WHERE id = OLD.event_id) <> 'upcoming' AND (SELECT deleted_at FROM events WHERE id = OLD.event_id) IS NULL)OR(NEW.tournament_format IS NOT OLD.tournament_format AND((SELECT status FROM events WHERE id = OLD.event_id) <> 'registration' OR OLD.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM matches WHERE division_id = OLD.id)))BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'division setup or tournament format is locked');END

CREATE TRIGGER matches_final_score_insert_guard BEFORE INSERT ON matches WHEN NEW.status = 'completed' AND NOT(((max(NEW.side_one_score, NEW.side_two_score) = 11 AND min(NEW.side_one_score, NEW.side_two_score) BETWEEN 0 AND 9)OR(min(NEW.side_one_score, NEW.side_two_score) >= 10 AND abs(NEW.side_one_score - NEW.side_two_score) = 2))AND NEW.winner_team_id = CASE WHEN NEW.side_one_score > NEW.side_two_score THEN NEW.side_one_team_id ELSE NEW.side_two_team_id END)BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'invalid final score or derived winner');END

CREATE TRIGGER matches_final_score_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON matches WHEN NEW.status = 'completed' AND NOT(((max(NEW.side_one_score, NEW.side_two_score) = 11 AND min(NEW.side_one_score, NEW.side_two_score) BETWEEN 0 AND 9)OR(min(NEW.side_one_score, NEW.side_two_score) >= 10 AND abs(NEW.side_one_score - NEW.side_two_score) = 2))AND NEW.winner_team_id = CASE WHEN NEW.side_one_score > NEW.side_two_score THEN NEW.side_one_team_id ELSE NEW.side_two_team_id END)BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'invalid final score or derived winner');END

CREATE TRIGGER matches_completed_result_lock BEFORE UPDATE ON matches WHEN OLD.status = 'completed' AND(NEW.side_one_score IS NOT OLD.side_one_score OR NEW.side_two_score IS NOT OLD.side_two_score OR NEW.winner_team_id IS NOT OLD.winner_team_id OR NEW.side_one_team_id IS NOT OLD.side_one_team_id OR NEW.side_two_team_id IS NOT OLD.side_two_team_id)AND(NEW.side_one_team_id IS NOT OLD.side_one_team_id OR NEW.side_two_team_id IS NOT OLD.side_two_team_id OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM match_result_revisions AS r WHERE r.match_id = OLD.id AND json_extract(r.previous_result, '$.version') = OLD.version AND json_extract(r.previous_result, '$.side_one_score') = OLD.side_one_score AND json_extract(r.previous_result, '$.side_two_score') = OLD.side_two_score))BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'audited result correction required');END
CREATE TRIGGER match_result_revisions_update_lock BEFORE UPDATE ON match_result_revisions BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'immutable result revision');END
CREATE TRIGGER match_result_revisions_delete_lock BEFORE DELETE ON match_result_revisions BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'immutable result revision');END
